```yaml
name: Ampcode PR Review
on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, staging]
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

jobs:
  review:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        node-version: [18.x]
      max-parallel: 3
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }}
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install Ampcode CLI
        run: |
          npm install -g @sourcegraph/amp
        env:
          NPM_CONFIG_REGISTRY: https://registry.npmjs.org/

      - name: Get changed files
        id: changed-files
        uses: tj-actions/changed-files@v41
        with:
          files: |
            **/*.ts
            **/*.tsx
            **/*.js
            **/*.jsx
            **/*.py
            **/*.go
            **/*.java
            **/*.cpp
            **/*.c
            **/*.h
            **/*.hpp
            **/*.php
            **/*.rb
            **/*.swift
            **/*.scala
            **/*.rs
            **/*.sql
            **/*.sh
            **/*.yml
            **/*.yaml
            **/*.json
          json: true

      - name: Run Ampcode Analysis
        id: ampcode
        if: steps.changed-files.outputs.any_changed == 'true'
        run: |
          echo "Analyzing ${{ steps.changed-files.outputs.all_changed_files }} files"
          # Limit to 50 changed files to prevent resource exhaustion
          CHANGED_FILES=$(echo "${{ steps.changed-files.outputs.all_changed_files }}" | head -n 50)
          echo "Processing files: $CHANGED_FILES"
          
          # Run ampcode analysis
          OUTPUT=$(amp --api-key="${{ secrets.AMPCODE_API_KEY }}" --format=json $CHANGED_FILES 2>&1) || true
          
          # Save output to file for later use
          echo "$OUTPUT" > ampcode_output.json
          
          # Check if there are any issues
          if [[ "$OUTPUT" != *"No issues found"* ]]; then
            echo "issues_found=true" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          fi
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Post Review Comments
        if: env.issues_found == 'true' && steps.changed-files.outputs.any_changed == 'true'
        run: |
          # Read the ampcode output
          OUTPUT=$(cat ampcode_output.json)
          
          # Process the JSON output and post comments
          echo "$OUTPUT" | jq -r '.[] | "\(.file):\(.line):\(.message)"' | while read -r line; do
            if [[ ! -z "$line" ]]; then
              FILE=$(echo "$line" | cut -d':' -f1)
              LINE=$(echo "$line" | cut -d':' -f2)
              MESSAGE=$(echo "$line" | cut -d':' -f3-)
              
              # Skip if file doesn't exist or line is not valid
              if [[ -f "$FILE" ]] && [[ "$LINE" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then
                echo "Posting comment for $FILE:$LINE - $MESSAGE"
                # Post comment using GitHub API
                curl -X POST \
                  -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" \
                  -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3+json" \
                  -d "{\"body\":\"Ampcode AI Review: $MESSAGE\",\"path\":\"$FILE\",\"line\":$LINE}" \
                  "https://api.github.com/repos/${{ github.repository }}/pulls/${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}/comments"
              fi
            fi
          done
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Handle Errors
        if: failure()
        run: |
          echo "Workflow failed, cleaning up..."
          # Any cleanup logic can go here
          exit 1

      - name: Cleanup
        if: always()
        run: |
          # Remove temporary files
          rm -f ampcode_output.json
```
